What We Do

Complete Septic Solutions

From routine maintenance to full system installs, Septic Tank Pumping Pros handles every aspect of your septic needs in the Bay Area.

Septic Tank Pumping

Regular pumping removes sludge before it causes backups, odors, or drain field damage. We recommend every 3–5 years for most households.

  • Residential & commercial tanks
  • Tanks of all shapes and sizes
  • Clean, fast, no mess left behind

Drain Field Installation

When your leach field fails, we design and install a new one that meets California code and lasts for decades.

  • Full system design & permits
  • Soil perc testing
  • Code-compliant installation

Grease Trap Cleaning

Restaurants and food service businesses rely on us for scheduled grease trap maintenance and emergency cleanouts.

  • Scheduled programs available
  • Compliance documentation
  • Proper CA-regulated disposal

24/7 Emergency Service

Sewage backup doesn't wait for business hours. Our team responds day or night, weekends and holidays.

  • Same-day response available
  • Weekend & holiday service
  • Fast arrival, Bay Area wide

Our Story

Over 50 Years of
Family Service

Septic Tank Pumping Pros began in the early 1970s when Daniel's father founded the company on a simple promise: show up, do the job right, and charge a fair price. That philosophy earned a loyal customer base that's stayed with us for generations.

In September 1998, Daniel Sexton III took the helm—bringing over 25 years of hands-on experience with him. He's expanded the operation, added grease trap services, and extended coverage across Northern California and Illinois, while keeping the values that built the business in the first place.

"My father built something worth continuing. Every job we do, we're representing that legacy."
— Daniel Sexton III, Owner
1972
Est. By the Sexton Family
Commercial Services

Grease Trap
Cleaning

FOG violations (fats, oils, grease) are the #1 cause of sanitary sewer overflows. Keep your kitchen compliant and your business out of trouble with our grease trap maintenance programs.

  • Scheduled monthly or quarterly service plans
  • Emergency overflow response, 24/7
  • Service manifests & compliance documentation
  • Proper disposal per California regulations
  • Restaurants, food trucks & commercial kitchens

Time to Call Us If You Notice...

Don't wait for a full backup. These early warning signs mean your system needs attention now.

Slow-draining sinks, tubs, or toilets
Gurgling sounds in drains or pipes
Sewage odors inside or outside your home
Wet spots or extra-green patches near drain field
Sewage backing up into home drains
More than 3 years since your last pump-out
